invited.title: You're invited
invited.lede: Somebody in the group sent you the link. Sign in with your Google account and you are one of us. No new password.
invited.reassurance: From the account we take only your name, your email and your photo. The invitation is what grants access, and the committee can cut it off if it leaks.

open.title: Ask to join
open.lede: You got here without an invitation. Sign in with Google and the committee will let you in by hand, usually the same day.
open.reassurance: From the account we take only your name, your email and your photo. Until you are approved you can see the events, but you cannot sign up for them.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.lede: We sent it to {{email}}. If it isn't there, check spam.
sent.link: Tap the link in the email and you're in.
sent.orCode: Or, if you prefer, type the six-digit code in that same email.
sent.linkOpensSafari: The link opens Safari, and from there you would not end up in here. Type the code and it works first time.

errors.sendFailed: We could not send the email. Please try again in a moment.
errors.badCode: That code is not right, or it has expired. Ask for another.
errors.googleFailed: We could not reach Google. Please try again in a moment.

entry.stranded: It looks like you signed in but the session stayed in the browser rather than here. Open the app from Safari, or tell the committee and we will sort it out.
entry.emailFallback: Or, if Google is not working for you, sign in with your email.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.offline: An internet connection is needed to see this.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.

rank.nudge: The ones above you are not resting.

recap.title: Last time
recap.were_one: {{count}} was there and we still laugh about it
recap.were_other: {{count}} of us were there and we still laugh about it

upcoming.title: What else is coming
upcoming.thatIsAll: And after that, nothing yet. Relax, something will turn up.
upcoming.none: Nothing else on the calendar yet. Relax, something will turn up.

empty.title: Nothing right now
empty.body: There is nothing on the calendar. Relax, something will turn up.

waiting.banner: You are still on the waiting list. You can see what is coming, but you cannot sign up until the committee lets you in.

install.title: Put it on your screen
install.lede: Two taps and it behaves like a real app. Without it there are no alerts when places open, and they will go to someone else.

step1.title: Tap Share, at the bottom
step1.body: It's the little square with the arrow pointing up, in the middle of the Safari bar.

step2.title: Scroll down to "Add to Home Screen"
step2.body: It's further down the list. Then Add, top right.

payoff.title: What you get
payoff.body: Alerts when places open, your QR without hunting for it, and full screen. In a normal browser tab the alerts never arrive: that's Apple, not us.

install.laterWarning: You can carry on here in the browser. Once you add it to your home screen you'll sign in one more time, because the iPhone treats them as two separate things.
install.iconPreview: This is how it will sit among your apps. The red icon is easy to spot when you are in a hurry.

ranking.schoolsLede: Everything you do counts for your school, whether you are 3rd or 60th.
ranking.cutOff: That is as far as the list goes. If you cannot see yourself, you need to get out more.

scanner.okWalkin: Not on the list, but come on in
scanner.okWalkinReview: Let them in — not signed up and not paid
scanner.alreadyCheckedIn: This QR has already been used
scanner.notAMember: This QR isn't one of ours
scanner.queued: Saved. It will send once there's signal

state.empty: Nothing right now. Something will turn up
